exposure: rAFS stage III and IV endometriosis
cohort: 240 pregnant women who underwent IVF; 80 with rAFS stage III and IV endometriosis (group A) and 160 without endometriosis (group B)
finding: Women with rAFS stage III and IV endometriosis who underwent IVF had a higher risk of placenta previa and cesarean section compared to women without endometriosis.
mod_finding: Women with rAFS stage III and IV endometriosis who underwent IVF had statistically higher rates of cesarean section compared to women without endometriosis.
